key_facts.fact: This was a single-arm feasibility study at three sites with 84 enrolled participants; 79 completed the week-12 visit. The primary operational endpoint was completion of scheduled remote check-ins, achieved by 68 of 79 completers. The report records six serious adverse events, all assessed by investigators as unrelated to the digital intervention. The study was not powered to establish clinical efficacy and had no control group. Exploratory symptom scores improved from baseline, but the report states that causality cannot be inferred. A larger controlled study is planned, pending funding and ethics approval.
